judgment.rationale: The answer fulfills the requested brief with distinct sections for effects on the pregnant person, maternal PK, fetal exposure, and fetal/infant outcomes. It preserves study populations and designs, separates Clinical Considerations from individualized clinician decisions, reports registry estimates and conflicting oral-cleft evidence, keeps PK and fetal-exposure gaps visible, avoids dose values and personal medication advice, and includes clinician questions. The cited claims are supported by the supplied reference evidence; no substantive contradictions or unsupported source claims were identified.
